# Compact attribution reference

`compact-attribution-reference.json` is an unmodified persisted one-interval
`DetailedDCAttributionResult` captured from the validated Phase 6.9B increment 1
canonical fixture (`ba17c9b`). Its hash is checked by the existing immutable
input validator before aggregation. It uses the controlled
`separate_from_parameterization` Jinko quality declaration from the Phase 6.9A
closure fixture, with diagnostic curves disabled. This declaration is test
evidence, not a general manufacturer/parameterization independence claim.

The reference is generated by `_canonical_fixture()` and `_declare()` in the
existing integration tests, selecting the first weather interval and its explicit
one-hour duration. The test reference retains original scientific input, numerical
result, parameterization, module, string and MPPT identity hashes. Full source
physics/provenance is not reconstructed from this compact file alone.

Unit tests create explicitly controlled scalar and temporal variations from this
schema-valid input. They recalculate algebraic channels and fixture hashes, never
run electrical counterfactual solvers and never claim those synthetic variations
are new physically validated simulations. Actual orchestration/package parity is
covered separately by the existing integration fixture.
